name: The Kellogg household at 1923 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_kellogg_mrs_c_p

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 1923 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 1923 Mrs. C. P. Kellogg; Mrs. Lois Kellogg.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 1923, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. A house of this kind kept live-in staff, and the 1900 and 1910 censuses name them; neither was read for this card, so no staff are listed. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: Mrs. Lois Kellogg
persons.note: Listed at 1923 in both editions. The Blue Book does not say how she was related to Mrs. C. P. Kellogg.
